DESCRIPTION:
*If you need something a little bit off the wall in our sphere of photonics and networks, you’ve come to the right place.*

*A technical, problem-solving, and creative company*

Laser 2000 is well known for its knowledgeable and open sales team; we’re great at providing just the sort of product advice our customers need. But maybe our biggest secret is that we create solutions from scratch too; we have excellent capabilities in product design and customisation.

*Knowledge is power!*

We know our industry inside out, and we know from experience how best to approach an application, no matter how challenging it may be. Whether it’s adding a base plate, changing firmware, altering a beam diameter, or creating a unique product, we can construct or adapt optics and lasers for all kinds of unusual applications.

*Back to basics*

We start off by talking to you about your application, going back to the basics of what you want to achieve, and how best to achieve it. The choice of technology – whether it’s an off-the-shelf product or a bespoke solution – is not necessarily the most obvious one. You have to be sure that you choose the most reliable, the easiest to deliver, and the most cost-effective option. Making that decision is sometimes quite complex, but we have the experience to help you make that choice.

*Little or large*

We have a wealth of experience in building and customising products, from the tiniest optical component to comprehensive projects of literally huge proportions. What they all have in common is trust – the trust we have built with our customers, because they know that we know our business, and that we’ll support them with the best solutions possible.
